'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / Invest In The Future]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
